# Specifics

## Metadata

Common metadata at the top of each `.qmd` file is as follows:

```
---
title: "Style guide"
description: "Overview of the principles and specific steps we use to make our material professional and consistent"
date: 2026-09-29
date-modified: last-modified
draft: true
---
```

-   `title` - states the (short) name of the page

## Page overview

Each page should start with a sentence or two at the top introducing the metarial, then headings per topic, and sub-headings (h2) for sub-parts
